an4.36:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā antarā ca ukkaṭṭhaṃ antarā ca setabyaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.36:1.2: doṇopi brāhmaṇo antarā ca ukkaṭṭhaṃ antarā ca setabyaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti
an4.36:1.3: addasā kho doṇo brāhmaṇo bhagavato pādesu cakkāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāni
an4.36:1.5: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
an4.36:1.7: athakho bhagavā maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an4.36:1.8: athakho doṇo brāhmaṇo bhagavato pādāni anugacchanto addasa bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ pāsādikaṃ pasādanīyaṃ santindriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttamadamathasamathamanuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ santindriyaṃ nāgaṃ
an4.36:1.9: disvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an4.36:2.2: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa devo bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:2.4: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa gandhabbo bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:2.6: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa yakkho bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:2.8: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa manusso bhavissāmīti.
an4.36:3.1: devo no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.2: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa devo bhavissāmīti vadesi
an4.36:3.3: gandhabbo no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.4: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa gandhabbo bhavissāmīti vadesi
an4.36:3.5: yakkho no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.6: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa yakkho bhavissāmīti vadesi
an4.36:3.7: manusso no bhavaṃ bhavissatīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.36:3.8: na kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa manusso bhavissāmīti vadesi
an4.36:4.1: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa āsavānaṃ appahīnattā devo bhaveyyaṃ te me āsavā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃ katā āyatiṃanuppādadhammā
an4.36:4.2: yesaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa āsavānaṃ appahīnattā gandhabbo bhaveyyaṃ … yakkho bhaveyyaṃ … manusso bhaveyyaṃ te me āsavā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃ katā āyatiṃanuppādadhammā
an4.36:4.3: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaḍḍhaṃ udakaṃ accuggamma tiṭṭhati anupalittaṃ udakena
an4.36:4.4: evameva kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa loke jāto loke saṃvaḍḍho lokaṃ abhibhuyya viharāmi anupalitto lokena
